# MetaVex Digital

> MetaVex Digital (metavex.digital) is an Indian digital services startup. It builds websites, runs Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads, sets up WhatsApp replies and follow-up automation, creates social media content and Reels, and automates business workflows for small and growing businesses across India.

Key facts:

- Name: MetaVex Digital (also written Metavex Digital)
- Website: https://metavex.digital
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9026231351
- Email: metavexdigital@gmail.com
- Service area: businesses across India
- Pricing: custom written quote based on scope, shared before work starts; no fixed packages are published
- MetaVex Digital does not guarantee leads, sales, ad returns, or search rankings, and does not publish invented reviews or case studies

## Services

- [Website development](https://metavex.digital/services/website-development): mobile-first business websites, landing pages and online stores with WhatsApp, call and form inquiries, payments and search-ready foundations
- [Facebook and Instagram ads (Meta ads)](https://metavex.digital/services/meta-ads): campaign planning, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking, creative testing and plain-language reporting
- [WhatsApp automation](https://metavex.digital/services/whatsapp-automation): automated first replies, catalog sharing, inquiry collection, team handover, Google Sheets or CRM updates and WhatsApp Business API setup
- [Social media content and Reels](https://metavex.digital/services/social-media-content): monthly content plans, Reels, posts, carousels and profile optimisation
- [Business workflow automation](https://metavex.digital/services/business-automation): leads, orders, payments and follow-up reminders connected across website forms, WhatsApp, Google Sheets and CRMs
- [All services](https://metavex.digital/services)
